description.when: Use this repair only when its stated factual and legal conditions apply.
description.repair: Apply a strict operative-grant test to every proposed citation: quote its legal function in a short internal paraphrase and include it only if the provision itself says that the asset or its described category is exempt or protected. Exclude provisions whose function is only to define, limit, cap, allocate, combine, elect, or administer another exemption; use them to test eligibility or amount, but do not report them separately. Match property categories narrowly by ordinary meaning and the statute's express examples; personal use or wearability alone does not transform an item into a listed category. Check ownership, use, residence, value, and aggregate-cap conditions. If no operative grant expressly covers the asset, output an empty array. Before submission, audit each citation with the question: “If every other provision were removed, would this text itself authorize protection of this asset?” If not, delete it. Return exactly the required asset-reference keys and only allowed citation-label IDs.
description.avoid_when: Do not apply outside the repair's stated conditions or exceptions.
